speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Safety and security are cornerstones of Singapore's stability and economic development.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To keep Singapore safe and secure, the Home Team will maintain a high level of operational excellence and preparedness.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also step up efforts to deal with new and growing challenges.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: At the global level, terrorism, cybercrime and transnational crime continue to pose serious threats to our safety and security.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The ongoing conflict in Syria and Iraq and the rise of ISIS have heightened the global terrorism threat.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The recent attacks in Paris and elsewhere demonstrate that the global threat of violent extremism is real and present.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In our region, the situation has become more serious.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: ISIS has attracted many foreign fighters to join its fight in Syria and Iraq.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: When these people return, they will have the capacity to do harm, given their combat experience and networks.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Transnational crime and cybercrime will also pose a challenge.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The movement of people and goods across countries has made crime increasingly cross-border in nature.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Syndicates and individuals are exploiting the speed, convenience and anonymity of the Internet to commit or enable crimes, such as theft and fraud.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our law enforcement agencies have detected the work of transnational syndicates behind serious criminal offences, such as drug trafficking and illegal bookmaking.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: These security and crime trends are taking place amid attempts to change global norms and Singapore's demographic shifts.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: There are attempts by some countries to decriminalise drug consumption and possession, as well as to adopt practices, such as drug-substitution therapies and needle-exchange programmes for intravenous drug-users.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For countries where drug consumption rates are high and out of control, they believe that such approaches will reduce the collateral harm of drug abuse.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: On the domestic front, Singapore's population will age and become more diverse.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Traveller and cargo volumes at our checkpoints will increase due to upcoming developments, such as Changi Airport Terminal 4.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: While our work will grow in load and complexity, there is a limit to how much we can grow the size of the Home Team, given Singapore's manpower constraints.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will have to develop new operating models and concepts and make better use of technology.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Over the next term of Government, MHA will focus on four key areas.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: First, we have to further step up our security responses to the evolving terror threat.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) will strengthen border security capabilities to bolster our first line of defence.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPF will consider the feasibility of installing more Police Cameras in our HDB estates, including HDB blocks, as well as other public areas, to enhance our ability to prevent, deter and detect criminal and terrorist threats.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPF will work with commercial and private establishments to enhance their security measures.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also engage our community partners and grassroots organisations on programmes to strengthen community vigilance, cohesion and resilience.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Terrorists aim to strike fear and divide 	Page: 39 society.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will build upon the Community Engagement Programme to ensure that our communities remain vigilant against such threats and stay united should an attack take place.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will conduct regular and realistic exercises to develop local communities to be better prepared and resilient in the event of crises.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Second, the Home Team will review the way it operates and develop new operating models, to cope with increasing demands amid manpower constraints.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will adopt a data-driven, tiered and differentiated frontline response model to serve the public better.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: It will not be realistic for the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) to continually expand its ambulance fleet and personnel at the same rate.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SCDF will review how it can better tier its emergency ambulance response – in terms of speed of response and manpower deployed – based on the severity of the cases.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Data analytics is a crucial enabler for such a response model.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: It allows us to analyse the data, discern patterns and deploy our resources dynamically to where they are most needed.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Third, we will adopt a holistic approach towards safety and security issues that covers not only intervention, but also upstream measures.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will review our laws to keep them relevant and effective against emerging threats.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also scale up our public education efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For example, the Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB) is expanding its outreach to parents to get them involved in keeping their children away from drugs.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPF will also be stepping up its engagement efforts to tackle the rising incidence of cybercrime.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Community engagement is a key plank of such an approach.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We have been working closely with local communities, through initiatives, such as SPF's Citizens-on-Patrol and SCDF's Save-a-Life.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In the coming years, we will take community partnerships to a higher level.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will deepen our cooperation and partnerships with international organisations, such as INTERPOL, ASEAN and the UN.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This is critical, given the transnational nature of crime and security threats.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To address emerging threats more effectively, we are actively exploring new partnerships.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For example, we will tap the expertise of organisations, such as INTERPOL, to develop our horizon-scanning capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This will allow us to better detect emerging trends that have security implications, before their effects are manifest.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To combat cybercrime, we will work with INTERPOL and regional counterparts to set up information-sharing platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Fourth, we will build a stronger and more integrated Home Team.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This will help us better deal with issues that span different Home Team Departments.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will more holistically integrate intelligence efforts, investigations and operations across Home Team Departments.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our Home Team officers are at the heart of everything we do.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will step up efforts to recruit, develop and retain capable and committed people.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will partner leading institutions, such as local Universities, business schools and corporate universities, to deliver high-quality training and develop Home Team officers to their fullest potential.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Page: 40 Our transformation plans for Home Team NS will see more NSFs and NSmen assume leadership and specialist positions.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: By better leveraging their capabilities, we hope to make their NS experience more challenging, meaningful and satisfying.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Home Team will maintain a high level of operational excellence and preparedness, even as we embark on our long-term transformation efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will strengthen community resilience and ensure that our society remains cohesive and united.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We treasure the trust and confidence that Singaporeans have placed in us.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Together, with the community, we will keep Singapore safe and secure.
